'''Vimriss''' was a member of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was used as a messenger or proxy for [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Green]].
